title: Feature Request: Track Insurer-Caused Delays for KPI Justification
description: Request for an enhancement to track and justify insurer-caused delays and poor communication. Scenario: An insurer issues a broad Purchase Order (e.g., 'leak to ceiling') for an Assessment Report, which implicitly requires specialist reports (e.g., roof report, leak detection) to determine the cause of damage. These specialist reports are often not explicitly covered by the initial PO. Problem: Engaging specialists and awaiting their reports, or waiting for insurer responses to requests for additional authorization, leads to delays in attendance and report submission. These delays are currently logged against the organization's KPIs. Desired Functionality: A mechanism within the system to flag or nominate the insurer as the cause of such delays. This data should be easily viewable based on claim/job life, justifiable against KPIs, and ideally, exportable as a document (e.g., for emailing to the insurer). This is an internal reporting request. The specific function and usability requirements can be discussed further with Brett and Matt Nash, as this idea has emerged from recent help discussions and requires review and fine-tuning.
